coverageNote: Government-source observations only; one-point series are intentional where the official release is a point-in-time or period-specific release. Missing periods are not inferred.

series.title: Real GDP growth (FY 2023-24)
series.description: Annual real GDP growth reported in the Economic Survey.
series.sourceOrganization: Government of India, Ministry of Finance
series.sourceNote: FY 2023-24 (April 2023–March 2024), real GDP at 2011-12 prices; fiscal year is represented by its ending year.
series.evidence: Economic Survey 2023-24: “real GDP growth ... was 8.2 per cent in 2023-24.”

series.title: Per-capita GDP growth (FY 2023-24)
series.sourceOrganization: Government of India, Ministry of Finance
series.sourceNote: FY 2023-24 (April 2023–March 2024), real per-capita GDP growth; fiscal year represented by ending year.
series.evidence: Economic Survey 2023-24, per-capita income table: real per-capita GDP growth for FY 2023-24 is 7.6 per cent.

series.title: CPI inflation (FY 2023-24)
series.description: Average consumer-price inflation for the fiscal year.
series.sourceOrganization: Government of India, Ministry of Finance
series.sourceNote: FY 2023-24 (April 2023–March 2024), average headline CPI inflation.
series.evidence: Economic Survey 2023-24: average headline CPI inflation was 5.4 per cent in FY 2023-24.

series.title: Central fiscal deficit (FY 2023-24)
series.sourceOrganization: Government of India, Ministry of Finance
series.sourceNote: FY 2023-24 (April 2023–March 2024), central government fiscal deficit as share of GDP; not general government.
series.evidence: Economic Survey 2023-24: central government fiscal deficit was 5.6 per cent of GDP in FY 2023-24.

series.title: Merchandise exports (FY 2023-24)
series.sourceOrganization: Government of India, Ministry of Finance
series.sourceNote: FY 2023-24 (April 2023–March 2024), merchandise exports; excludes services.
series.evidence: Economic Survey 2023-24, external sector table: merchandise exports were US$437.1 billion in FY 2023-24.

series.title: Merchandise imports (FY 2023-24)
series.sourceOrganization: Government of India, Ministry of Finance
series.sourceNote: FY 2023-24 (April 2023–March 2024), merchandise imports; excludes services.
series.evidence: Economic Survey 2023-24, external sector table: merchandise imports were US$675.4 billion in FY 2023-24.

series.title: Merchandise trade deficit (FY 2023-24)
series.sourceOrganization: Government of India, Ministry of Finance
series.sourceNote: FY 2023-24 (April 2023–March 2024), merchandise imports minus merchandise exports.
series.evidence: Economic Survey 2023-24, external sector table: merchandise trade deficit was US$238.3 billion in FY 2023-24.

series.title: Services exports (FY 2023-24)
series.sourceOrganization: Government of India, Ministry of Finance
series.sourceNote: FY 2023-24 (April 2023–March 2024), services exports.
series.evidence: Economic Survey 2023-24, external sector table: services exports were US$341.1 billion in FY 2023-24.

series.title: Current-account balance (FY 2023-24)
series.sourceOrganization: Government of India, Ministry of Finance
series.sourceNote: FY 2023-24 (April 2023–March 2024), current-account balance as share of GDP; negative means deficit.
series.evidence: Economic Survey 2023-24, balance-of-payments discussion: FY 2023-24 current-account deficit was 0.7 per cent of GDP.

series.title: FDI inflows (FY 2023-24)
series.sourceOrganization: Government of India, Ministry of Finance
series.sourceNote: FY 2023-24 (April 2023–March 2024), gross foreign direct investment inflows.
series.evidence: Economic Survey 2023-24, external sector table: gross FDI inflows were US$70.95 billion in FY 2023-24.

series.title: Industrial GVA growth (FY 2023-24)
series.description: Annual real industry gross value added growth.
series.sourceOrganization: Government of India, Ministry of Finance
series.sourceNote: FY 2023-24 (April 2023–March 2024), real industry GVA growth.
series.evidence: Economic Survey 2023-24, sector table: industry GVA grew 9.7 per cent in FY 2023-24.

series.title: Manufacturing GVA growth (FY 2023-24)
series.description: Annual real manufacturing gross value added growth.
series.sourceOrganization: Government of India, Ministry of Finance
series.sourceNote: FY 2023-24 (April 2023–March 2024), real manufacturing GVA growth.
series.evidence: Economic Survey 2023-24, sector table: manufacturing GVA grew 9.9 per cent in FY 2023-24.

series.title: Agriculture GVA growth (FY 2023-24)
series.description: Annual real agriculture and allied gross value added growth.
series.sourceOrganization: Government of India, Ministry of Finance
series.sourceNote: FY 2023-24 (April 2023–March 2024), real agriculture and allied GVA growth.
series.evidence: Economic Survey 2023-24, sector table: agriculture and allied GVA grew 1.4 per cent in FY 2023-24.

series.title: Services GVA growth (FY 2023-24)
series.description: Annual real services gross value added growth.
series.sourceOrganization: Government of India, Ministry of Finance
series.sourceNote: FY 2023-24 (April 2023–March 2024), real services GVA growth.
series.evidence: Economic Survey 2023-24, sector table: services GVA grew 7.6 per cent in FY 2023-24.

series.title: Union government capital expenditure (FY 2023-24 PA)
series.description: Union government capital expenditure budget estimate.
series.sourceOrganization: Government of India, Ministry of Finance
series.sourceNote: Provisional Actual (PA) for FY 2023-24 (April 2023–March 2024); total capital expenditure, not a budget estimate.
series.evidence: Budget at a Glance 2024-25: “In PA of FY 2023-24, the total capital expenditure was at ₹9,48,506 crore.”

series.title: Gross GST collections (FY 2023-24)
series.description: Gross goods and services tax collections.
series.sourceOrganization: Government of India, Ministry of Finance
series.sourceNote: FY 2023-24 (April 2023–March 2024), gross GST collections.
series.evidence: Economic Survey 2023-24: gross GST collections were ₹20.18 lakh crore in FY 2023-24.

series.title: Usual-status unemployment rate (PLFS 2023-24)
series.description: Unemployment rate from the annual PLFS usual-status measure.
series.sourceOrganization: Government of India, Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
series.sourceNote: PLFS 2023-24 (July 2023–June 2024), usual status (principal status plus subsidiary status), age 15+; annual survey, not calendar year.
series.evidence: PLFS 2023-24 press note, usual status (ps+ss), age 15 years and above: unemployment rate 3.2 per cent.

series.title: Usual-status LFPR (PLFS 2023-24)
series.sourceOrganization: Government of India, Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
series.sourceNote: PLFS 2023-24 (July 2023–June 2024), usual status, age 15+; annual survey, not calendar year.
series.evidence: PLFS 2023-24 press note, usual status (ps+ss), age 15 years and above: LFPR 60.1 per cent.

series.title: Usual-status worker population ratio (PLFS 2023-24)
series.sourceOrganization: Government of India, Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
series.sourceNote: PLFS 2023-24 (July 2023–June 2024), usual status, age 15+; annual survey, not calendar year.
series.evidence: PLFS 2023-24 press note, usual status (ps+ss), age 15 years and above: WPR 58.2 per cent.

series.title: Repo rate (June 2024 policy decision)
series.sourceOrganization: Reserve Bank of India
series.sourceNote: Policy rate effective after the 7 June 2024 MPC decision; point-in-time rate, not an annual average.
series.evidence: RBI Monetary Policy Statement, June 7 2024: “Keep the policy repo rate ... unchanged at 6.50 per cent.”

series.title: Standing deposit facility rate (June 2024 policy decision)
series.sourceOrganization: Reserve Bank of India
series.sourceNote: Rate effective after the 7 June 2024 MPC decision; point-in-time rate, not an annual average.
series.evidence: RBI Monetary Policy Statement, June 7 2024: “the standing deposit facility (SDF) rate remains unchanged at 6.25 per cent.” This record is relabeled SDF; it is not a CRR.

series.title: Electricity generation (FY 2023-24)
series.sourceOrganization: Government of India, Ministry of Finance
series.sourceNote: FY 2023-24 (April 2023–March 2024), total electricity generation; fiscal year represented by ending year.
series.evidence: Economic Survey 2023-24, energy table: total electricity generation was 1,739.1 billion kWh in FY 2023-24.

series.title: Renewable energy capacity (March 2024)
series.sourceOrganization: Government of India, Ministry of Finance
series.sourceNote: Installed renewable capacity at 31 March 2024; stock, not generation during the year.
series.evidence: Economic Survey 2023-24, energy table: installed renewable capacity at 31 March 2024 was 190.57 GW.

series.title: National highway construction (FY 2023-24)
series.sourceName: Year End Review 2024: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
series.sourceOrganization: Government of India, Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
series.sourceNote: FY 2023-24 (April 2023–March 2024), national highways constructed; fiscal year represented by ending year.
series.evidence: MoRTH/PIB table: “2023-24 ... Construction (in km) ... 12349.”

series.title: Railway freight loading (FY 2023-24)
series.sourceOrganization: Government of India, Ministry of Finance
series.sourceNote: FY 2023-24 (April 2023–March 2024), originating freight loading by Indian Railways.
series.evidence: Economic Survey 2023-24, transport table: Indian Railways originating freight loading was 1,591.0 million tonnes in FY 2023-24.
